title: fix: minify zero-valued translate3d in a single pass
author: SyMind
summary: One-condition change in Transform::to_css: translate3d(x,0,0) now minifies to translate(x) even when x is zero, so translate3d(0,0,0) becomes translate(0) instead of translate(0,0). translate()'s omitted second argument is defined as 0, so the two outputs are identical functions; the 3D->2D conversion itself already exists on master. Tests cover units, -0, %, calc, prefixes, var() and non-minified output.
evidence: Master: `.foo{transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}` -> `.foo{transform:translate(0,0)}`. src/properties/transform.rs:1062 still has `!x.is_zero()`; the fall-through branch prints translate(x,y), so the change only shortens output. kdy1 (member) reviewed against CSS Transforms 1 §7.1/§10 on 2026-10-29 and asked for a rebase, which the author did on 2026-11-02.
